verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy question for any SaaS that holds customer data, including a business payments platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, data-use controls for model training, or any related privacy setting. The sandbox guidance about not including real data concerns test environments, not model training, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
